frozen_manifest.policy: Keep immutable for first independent evaluation; any later fix is a new version and evaluation becomes regression.

environment.note: Node-only artificial-input evaluation; not whole-app RAM or target-laptop validation.

resource_measurements.note: All inference latencies are direct synchronous calls, no new Worker per input. Process memory includes Node harness and imports. After-GC includes geometry, so it is not an isolated interpreter delta.
